category_title: Pupils with persistent disruptive and aggressive/abusive behavior
minimal_context: The student is expected to complete a silent reading assignment while seated among peers in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, please open your textbooks to page 42 and begin reading the chapter silently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Kicks the chair of the pupil sitting in front of them) I'm not reading this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stop distracting others and start your reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I wasn't even doing anything! He moved his chair back into my desk. It's his fault, not mine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The whole class is waiting for you to be quiet. Stop arguing and get to work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slams the textbook onto the floor and stands up) Why are you always picking on me in front of everyone?! I can’t control my behaviour when under pressure like this! I'm not doing your stupid work!

task.content: General classroom activity and responding to teacher direction

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Being told off in front of the class or when under pressure
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Defies teachers and/or refuses to obey rules, argues with teachers, loses temper, and becomes rude, resentful, angry, agitated, argumentative, bad-tempered and/or confrontational, resulting in a tantrum
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: I can’t control my behaviour when under pressure
related_quotes: Any situation like this results in a tantrum from . . .
I can’t control my behaviour when under pressure

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with peers in the classroom
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Deliberately does things to annoy other pupils, is touchy or easily annoyed by others, and is angry, resentful, spiteful or vindictive
